cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a tray above the model like you. Welcome rain. Your cloud sent a drop upward; let's get it to the roof garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's catching a roof leak. One upward drop doesn't mean the model can water the garden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leaks caught, yes. It did go up. Mark where it hit this tray so we can raise it another inch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you folded the pressure forecast under the tray? Is it high enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that sheet there. Move the tray up one mark and try another pulse; let's measure what it actually reaches.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies leak-catching as upward rain confidence; A3 uses actual rising drop; A5 hides forecast while proposing test. But marks on tray do not establish vertical increment and forecast drawback unspecified.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 limits one drop so A3 marks where it hit tray; B4 pressure question leads A5 up-one-mark, which cannot derive height from horizontal impact.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants actual garden capacity and B4 asks relevant pressure limit.

heightening.evidence: A5 proposes another pulse but its height instruction lacks defined scale.

specificity.evidence: A1 roof garden/model clear; A3/A5 mark location versus height incoherent.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 measure-what-it-reaches is purposeful but needs concrete reference.
